{
  "dataset_name": "postcutoff_clinical_trials_ai_20260517",
  "model_family": "tree",
  "schema_generator": "gpt-5.5-pro",
  "schema_version": "1.0.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "ai_use_code_band",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Coarse ordinal band for the encoded AI-use taxonomy: 0 unknown, 1 codes 0-2, 2 codes 3-5, 3 codes 6 and above.",
      "value_range": [
        0,
        3
      ],
      "feature_family": "ai_taxonomy",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a stable low-cardinality split over the AI-use taxonomy without requiring many narrow code splits.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(ai_use_type < 0, 0, np.where(ai_use_type <= 2, 1, np.where(ai_use_type <= 5, 2, 3)))"
    },
    {
      "name": "deployment_evidence_balance",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Difference between real-world deployment and evidence-strength scores.",
      "value_range": [
        -0.9,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "deployment_validation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Gives trees a direct thresholdable measure of deployment emphasis relative to formal validation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "real_world_deployment_score - evidence_strength_score"
    },
    {
      "name": "deployment_ahead_of_evidence_flag",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator for high deployment emphasis paired with modest evidence strength.",
      "value_range": [
        0,
        1
      ],
      "feature_family": "deployment_validation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures a nonlinear pattern that would otherwise require multiple nested splits.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((real_world_deployment_score >= 0.65) & (evidence_strength_score <= 0.35), 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "protocol_rigor_count",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Count of protocol maturity and rigor indicators: randomization, blinding, later phase, larger enrollment bucket, and stronger evidence score.",
      "value_range": [
        0,
        5
      ],
      "feature_family": "protocol_design",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Compresses several design-quality fields into an ordinal count that supports simple tree splits.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(has_randomization == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(has_blinding == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(trial_phase_bucket >= 2, 1, 0) + np.where(enrollment_bucket >= 2, 1, 0) + np.where(evidence_strength_score >= 0.5, 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "early_small_open_design_flag",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Indicator for known early-phase, small-enrollment, non-blinded study designs.",
      "value_range": [
        0,
        1
      ],
      "feature_family": "protocol_design",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a direct split for low-scale open designs, a useful interaction among phase, enrollment, and blinding.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((trial_phase_bucket >= 0) & (trial_phase_bucket <= 1) & (enrollment_bucket >= 0) & (enrollment_bucket <= 1) & (has_blinding != 1), 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "ai_specificity_term_count",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Count of explicit technical AI terms present in the row: AI, algorithm, machine learning, and deep learning.",
      "value_range": [
        0,
        4
      ],
      "feature_family": "ai_semantics",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Turns sparse mention flags into an ordinal specificity signal that trees can split on directly.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(mentions_ai == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(mentions_algorithm == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(mentions_machine_learning == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(mentions_deep_learning == 1, 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "digital_delivery_term_count",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Count of implementation-channel terms present in the row: software, mobile app, and wearable.",
      "value_range": [
        0,
        3
      ],
      "feature_family": "digital_delivery",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Summarizes product-like delivery channels in a compact count suited to threshold splits.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(mentions_software == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(mentions_mobile_app == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(mentions_wearable == 1, 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "governance_topic_count",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Count of governance-related topics present in the row: bias, safety, and privacy.",
      "value_range": [
        0,
        3
      ],
      "feature_family": "governance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Aggregates sparse governance mentions into a simple ordinal feature for direct splitting.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(mentions_bias == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(mentions_safety == 1, 1, 0) + np.where(mentions_privacy == 1, 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "geographic_reach_ordinal",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal geographic reach: 0 none or unknown, 1 single-country, 2 multi-country or explicitly international.",
      "value_range": [
        0,
        2
      ],
      "feature_family": "geographic_scope",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides an interpretable scale feature that combines country count and international-trial flag.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where((international_trial == 1) | (country_count >= 2), 2, np.where(country_count == 1, 1, 0))"
    },
    {
      "name": "trial_progress_ordinal",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Status precedence code: 0 other or unknown, 1 recruiting, 2 completed.",
      "value_range": [
        0,
        2
      ],
      "feature_family": "operational_status",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Collapses status indicators into a single ordered feature for concise progress-related splits.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(is_completed == 1, 2, np.where(is_recruiting == 1, 1, 0))"
    },
    {
      "name": "workflow_embedding_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Ordinal expert assessment from row metadata: 0 offline analytic use, 1 decision-support or algorithm evaluation, 2 participant- or clinician-facing digital delivery, 3 embedded real-world workflow or device-like deployment.",
      "value_range": [
        0,
        3
      ],
      "feature_family": "semantic_workflow",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Adds a compact semantic view of how deeply the AI system is embedded in practice, reducing reliance on several separate splits.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "translation_readiness_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Ordinal expert assessment from row metadata: 0 exploratory concept, 1 early feasibility, 2 structured prospective evaluation, 3 mature large or multicenter evaluation, 4 near-operational product or service readiness.",
      "value_range": [
        0,
        4
      ],
      "feature_family": "semantic_maturity",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Summarizes scale, evidence, deployment, and operational maturity into an interpretable ordinal feature for tree thresholds.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
